_readme: Every code path that applies the `needs-human` hold (DRE-6173). Read through scripts/hold.py; `python3 scripts/hold.py check` holds this file to the tree and to the contract, and docs/holds.md is the page a person reads. A row names its site by `file`, `scope` and `anchor` — a phrase in the scope's text that is never the label-write line — and carries each reason the site writes, the reason's lift kind, what the pipeline tries first, and the readers that honor it. The vocabulary below is the contract of epic DRE-6172, identical in every card of it.
label: needs-human

stranded-no-run.why: A run receipt newer than the stamp proves a run started. Nothing in the pipeline starts one on its own — the sweep skips a held card and the relay dispatches only on an entry to Todo — so the run that lifts it is the one a person's re-send starts.

no-route.why: Read off the card's CURRENT repo: label, never the stamp: the usual fix is a person correcting the label, which a lift reading the stamped slug would never see.

review-cap-spent.why: The review re-triggers were spent on one head; a pushed fix is a new head the review runs on again.

dead-run-cap.why: Only an operator's unpark resets the death budget, and its dead-run-budget-reset marker is the fact.

turn-cap-park.why: The same budget reset as the dead-run cap: two turn-cap deaths past green are the most a card gets.

epic-rereview-twice.why: The park ends in Triage for an operator and the way back is plan_critic.REAPPROVE_HOW, a person's act that leaves no fact a sweep can read.

plan-critic-bound.why: Every bound park ends in Triage for an operator and the way back is plan_critic.REAPPROVE_HOW, a person's act that leaves no fact a sweep can read.

fix-dispute.why: The fix loop's budget was spent on one head; a pushed fix is a new head the review, the gate and the fix loop run on again.

unfixable-check.why: The red check was read on one head (its receipt is keyed unfixable-check-hold @<sha8>); a new head is read again.

manual.why: A person chose it, or a writer created the card already held; nothing a sweep can read says it is over.

lift_kinds.run-started: A 🧠 or ⏳ run receipt newer than the stamp.
lift_kinds.repo-on-rail: Every repo: label the card wears now names a key of config/repo-map.json.
lift_kinds.new-head: The open pull request's head differs from the stamped sha.
lift_kinds.unpark-marker: A dead-run-budget-reset marker newer than the stamp.
lift_kinds.manual: Nothing a sweep can read: only card-closed or a person lifts it.

universal_lift.card-closed: Lifts every reason, and a label with no stamp, when the card is Done or Canceled.

readers.sweep: reconcile.held(): the sweep skips a held card entirely — no requeue, no nudge, no dispatch.
readers.fix-dispatch: reconcile.fix_dispatch_blocked(): the fix agent is kept off the held card's pull request.
readers.medic: medic_retry: the medic refuses its one automatic retry of a held card's build, fix, plan or review run.
readers.limit-recovery: limit_recovery: a held card's stages are not re-entered, save its sync bookkeeping.

stamp: 🔒 hold: reason=<code> at=<qualifier or none> lifts=<lift-kind> by=<writer-file>
lift_line: 🔓 hold lifted: reason=<code> because=<lift-kind or card-closed or operator> by=<writer-file>

sites.note: The stall watchdog. One label write, two reasons: a routable card no run ever started on (stranded-no-run), and a card whose repo is not on the dispatch rail (no-route).
